headline: Callahans Passage Erupts; Weathered Expanse Ground Shifts
war_summary: Since our last edition the fighting has broadened. Callahans Passage, quiet in recent reports, has erupted: four flag events inside two hours, Crumbling Post the liveliest post in the sector, casualty rates climbing steeply, with nine Warden stands against one Colonial. The Weathered Expanse has traded ground, its balance now four Warden posts to two Colonial with three in ruin, after some forty-three flag events in the day; Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk remain the busiest points. Mooring County's Wind Hills flare has returned, eight events in two hours, while Linn Mercy keeps up its churn, Rotdust and Lathair drawing the most flag traffic, the Colonials still holding ten of eleven stands. The Nevish Line leads the casualty ledger at some twenty-seven thousand in a day, its guns quickening again in the past hour though no flag has moved there since early morning. Stonecradle, by contrast, has gone quiet since the previous night. Elsewhere the front is largely static. It is day 760; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
